python3 << 'EOF'
import zipfile, re
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
print("Files in archive:")
for n in z.namelist():
    print(" ", n)

ns = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}

# shared strings
shared = []
if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
    for si in root.findall('m:si', ns):
        text = ''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
        shared.append(text)
print("\nShared strings:", shared)

# workbook sheets
wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
for sh in wb.find('m:sheets', ns):
    print("Sheet:", sh.get('name'), sh.get('sheetId'), sh.get('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id'))

# worksheets
for name in z.namelist():
    if re.match(r'xl/worksheets/sheet\d+\.xml', name):
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read(name))
        print("\n---", name, "---")
        for row in root.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}row'):
            cells = []
            for c in row:
                ref = c.get('r')
                t = c.get('t')
                v = c.find('m:v', ns)
                val = ''
                if t == 's' and v is not None:
                    val = shared[int(v.text)]
                elif v is not None:
                    val = v.text
                elif t == 'inlineStr':
                    is_ = c.find('m:is', ns)
                    val = ''.join(x.text or '' for x in is_.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
                cells.append(f"{ref}={val}")
            print(" | ".join(cells))
EOF

for m in re.finditer(r'<c r=\"([A-Z]+\d+)\"[^>]*>(<f>[^<]*</f>)?', xml):
    cell = m.group(1)
    if cell in ('B8','C23','B25') or m.group(2):
        print(m.group(0))
